description: Scenarios are regression tests kept in the project (.godotwright/scenarios/<name>.json) that godotwright ci runs: a scene, an input timeline and claims about what the game did, run headless in Godot 4.7 and deterministic. op `save` takes the arguments of a godot_play run (scene, input, watch, frames, until, signals, expect: at least one claim), runs it once more and writes it only when every claim holds (undo with godot_undo); `overwrite` replaces one. op `list` shows each scenario and its claims; op `run` runs all, or the one called `name` (else those whose name contains it), and returns PASS per scenario and every failing claim with the value the game had and the frame. An error result when a run fails or Godot is missing. After godot_play with `expect` proves a fix, save it so the next change cannot break it unnoticed.

input.description: save: timeline, "10 tap jump; 40 hold right 20"

name.description: save: the new scenario's name (letters, digits, _ or -); run and list: which ones (default all)

overwrite.description: save: replace a scenario with that name

path.description: project folder, or a file or folder inside it (relative to the server's folder; default: the current project)

scene.description: save: the res:// scene (default: the main scene)

until.description: save: stop when this holds; the scenario fails when it never does

name: godot_scenario
title: Keep and run scenario tests
